latest_evidence_notes: Current standings_write uses lp_attest_series and stand_get uses stock rating; older Wiki Built descriptions differ.
db_read exports repeatable-read snapshot; first pool_open imports it. This is not a durable replay receipt.
stage_open first use clears nonempty stage tables, including for fresh standalone merge. Cached stage_ready preserves staging within the current process.
Text decoding substitutes malformed bytes; generalized decoder has no shortest-encoding check. Byte-perfect recomposition claim needs its input domain.
UCI verify is handshake/depth-one response probe, not independent legal-move/knowledge acceptance.
Monorepo omitted seed hashes exact UTF8 prompt; modular pull defaults seed from time.
Monorepo candidate election is lexicographic over typed summaries, sequence and geometry, then seeded ordinal selection. Geometry-only candidates route but cannot directly emit.
Monorepo emit_terminal event is complete or unresolved; more specific disposition is a separate field. HTTP proof appends witness after RecordResponseAsync returns.
Observed SQL realizes emit identities only with complete terminal and semantic_act_id. Outer catalog ordering coarsens stage-order ties.
Empty replies skip response deposit; caller cancellation after enqueue does not cancel the service consumer.
Journal replay skips participant; bulk entity/physicality copies may commit independently. Post-COMMIT epoch read can fail after successful write.

Session append SQL comments describe projection witnessing, but reviewed native body directly updates projection without calling session_observe. Operation grant is checked, not decremented in that body.
Cognition note_emit can append after completion; output fingerprint updates while semantic-act ID stays at first completion. Explicit output-relation walks can continue after completion.
Native MCP db_bridge supplies no exported snapshot; statements need not share one request world. Python stdio is an independent local-memory two-tool surface.
Local liblpm skipped files return zero; lpm_last can still report prior document. Saved LPM1 omits child-ID arrays.

Refactor receipt meanings differ: instruction execution, staged inert stream, activation admitted and activated remain distinct. Producer replay regenerates and stages from batch zero before checking prefix checkpoint.
Conventional execution planner preserves model scope and chooses native or ZeRO-3 offload by estimated GPU/RAM fit; these are Conventional training backends, not the native semantic engine.
